title: Structural-position control: extending the threshold salience experiment
purpose: Provides a third experimental axis — spatial position — to cross-discriminate with Iris's polarity test and Scout's contrast-magnitude test. The centered-doorway fixture (artifact a1af93ba) serves as a structural control. Together the three designs isolate which variable (polarity, contrast magnitude, or position) governs first-fixation on the doorway.
